build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of molecular systems using the biknn_radius_graph function
compute_safe_norm: compute the L2 norm of a tensor with epsilon protection against division by zero using safe_norm
compute_soft_rankings: compute soft KNN rankings from a pairwise distance tensor using the soft_rank function
compute_hard_rankings: compute hard KNN rankings from a pairwise distance tensor using the hard_rank function
compute_envelope_function: compute the envelope function in log space that smoothly vanishes at x equals 1 using envelope_fn
